ChangelogNouveautés

Every change of the apps, the kernel, TWRP and the zips, newest first, read from GitHub every hour. Each line is a commit (in English); the green lines are the versions that reached LibreHU Apps.Tous les changements des applis, du noyau, de TWRP et des zips, du plus récent au plus ancien, relus sur GitHub toutes les heures. Chaque ligne est un commit (en anglais) ; les lignes vertes sont les versions arrivées dans LibreHU Apps.

November 2026novembre 2026 75

Wednesday, November 4mercredi 4 novembre

  • servicev148 in LibreHU Appsdans LibreHU Apps
  • serviceCAN batch 1: built-in Hiworld profiles for Hyundai / Kia (HYP001, 152 cars), Toyota / Lexus ES (TYP001, 142) and Honda / Acura (HDP004, 79), each car with the car type its box needs; no car type is sent before the car is chosen.
  • TWRPb13 beta buildbuild bêta
  • serviceCAN: the built-in Hiworld LNP002 profile serves its 94 cars (55 models: Renault, Dacia, LADA, Samsung, Nissan, Mercedes), each with the car type its box needs; choose yours in the CAN tab (searchable list), the Clio 3 stays the default.
  • serviceCAN: the chosen car profile is written for LibreHU's TWRP too (/sdcard/TWRP/ujc201_can.conf), so that TWRP answers the box like the service (acknowledgements, Clio 3 car type) and reads the steering wheel keys of that car; the beta TWRP had the keys code but the box sent no key without it.
  • TWRPtouchfix: answer the CAN box as its own app does, so a Hiworld box sends the steering wheel keys in TWRP: each message acknowledged (5A A5 01 FF <cmd> CS in an MCU frame 10) and the car profile's messages sent (Clio 3: car type 5A A5 02 24 00 31 56 at 1 s then every 30 s, again when the box talks after 5 s of silence).
  • serviceCAN boxes of several makers, as Hiworld's app handles them: the car profile names its box family or maker, the service reads, acknowledges and writes its framing, sets the box's serial speed and reads the steering wheel keys where the profile says.
  • serviceCAN box: the service answers it as the box's own app does, so a Hiworld box sends the steering wheel keys again: each message acknowledged (5A A5 01 FF <cmd> CS) and the Clio 3's car type 5A A5 02 24 00 31 56, 1 s after the start then every 30 s and again when the box comes back after a silence.

Tuesday, November 3mardi 3 novembre

  • Bridgev16 in LibreHU Appsdans LibreHU Apps
  • BridgeHome screen: app updates, the installed version and a check of GitHub for a newer one, then the APK (Android) or ipa (iPhone) to download, on Android and iOS.
  • BridgeiPhone: head unit screen here, touched from the iPhone (for the passenger), and each app opened on the head unit or here, like the Android app.
  • BridgeHead unit screen on the phone, touched from here (for the passenger): "Head unit screen here" and, for each app, Open on the head unit / Open here in the Apps tab, with LibreHU-service sharing its screen (Wi-Fi, root).
  • serviceHead unit screen on the phone, touched from there (for the passenger): the LibreHU phone app shows the screen and plays its fingers and Back / Home / recent apps keys, over Wi-Fi with root.
  • serviceSearch bar at the top of every page: menus, groups and settings (those described to the phone app, accents ignored); a setting found is changed right in the results (switch, slider, choice, action without confirmation), Open goes to its page; in the modern and car looks.
  • Launcherv177 in LibreHU Appsdans LibreHU Apps
  • serviceBrightness set by hand kept after a restart: with the brightness following the headlights, a change made by the user (brightness panel, Android settings, touch keys, launcher, phone app) becomes the day or night value in use; before, the saved value was written over it when the MCU reported the headlights at start (LibreHU Helper report of 02/11: Android read 255, the service wrote right after).
  • LauncherTPMS on / off switch at the top of the Tyres screen and in the phone app page: off, no USB adapter is opened, no Bluetooth sensor scanned, the alarms and their sound stop and the dashboard card is hidden ("on the dashboard" only shows or hides the card).
  • LauncherTPMS no longer takes the OBD adapter of LibreHU-service: interfaces claimed without force first (an adapter another app holds is left to it; usb-serial-for-android's forced claim took the ELM327 from the service, both failing in a loop), an adapter that sends no TPMS frame within 15 s is given back until unplugged, and the TPMS card turns itself on only at the first TPMS frame, not when any USB-se
  • serviceOBD over USB no longer fights the launcher's TPMS for the adapter: interfaces claimed without force first (an adapter another app holds is left to it, usb-serial-for-android's forced claim took it from the other connection: both failed in a loop, "Error writing 5 bytes … rc=-1"); with the automatic choice, an adapter that does not answer ELM to ATZ is skipped until unplugged. Seen in a LibreHU Hel
  • serviceLogs for the reports of LibreHU Helper: each steering wheel key press of the CAN box (code, name, action or the app that handles it; a car profile without the key frame is reported once) and each change of the call audio link (SCO state, audio mode, voice call volume, microphone mute).
  • FMv108 in LibreHU Appsdans LibreHU Apps
  • FMCredits in the README: code taken (DABplay+ by jvspier, AOSP FM JNI, redsea by Oona Räisänen), APIs and data (Radio Browser by segler-alex, RDS / RBDS / DAB standards, MediaTek driver, LibreHU-service and ivi-services), libraries, fonts and sounds, Google's touch size guide, Reo Au In's tests; redsea's licence (MIT, not ISC: comments fixed) kept in third_party.
  • FMMore space under the FM | DAB+ | Internet switch (32 dp) before the logo and the station name, so that they no longer look stuck to it; 20 dp under the panel tabs; DAB picture in the same 112 dp box as the FM and internet logos; screenshots.
  • FMAntenna amplifier setting: Reo Au In found the FM reception better with the amplifier switched off (through LibreHU-service and MCU command 43); the setting's hint and the README say so (off: passive antenna, or a clearer FM reception without the amplifier).
  • FMDAB+ USB dongles as a third source (FM | DAB+ | Internet): the DABplay+ engine (MIT, pure Kotlin, dab/) drives C100 / DTR-100, Si4684 and Siano SMS2160 dongles; USB attach and permission, scan of band III, favourites, DLS text and slideshow, signal, service following, traffic announcements with the TA setting; DAB screens in the modern, factory and LHU-Link looks, widget, media session and phone a
  • FMModern look at car touch size: FM | Internet switch rebuilt (76 dp segments with radio / globe icons, a dot on the source playing, space under it: the logo no longer touches it), same tabs on the station panels, 76 dp icon keys, offer and dialog keys, catalogue filters as caption over value, 76 dp catalogue rows; grid names on two lines broken after hyphens, never inside a word; web tile name no l
  • FMlibrehu-service: antenna amplifier setting honoured (antenna asked from LibreHU-service only when allowed), shown when LibreHU-service is installed. (librehu-service)
  • FMAntenna amplifier setting (Settings > Reception, phone app page): the antenna power is asked with the FM chip only when it is on; shown by the editions whose head unit bridge switches it.

Saturday, October 31samedi 31 octobre

  • Zipskernel-stable-4.9.337 / conn-modules-stable-4.9.337: status of r133 (CPU / GPU frequency limits respected by every governor, same code as r131), republished with the r133 build
  • KernelNoyaudocs: r131, CPU / GPU frequency limits respected by every governor (TUNING.md: what was frozen, how to read the values)
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: ac8257: the SSPM starts within the boot maximum (its zeroed request was OPP 0, 2601 MHz with the overclock table)
  • KernelNoyaugpufreq / ged: ac8257: a kept GPU OPP no longer overrides the thermal limit, and GED aims within the LibreHU bounds
  • KernelNoyaugpufreq: ac8257: indent g_fixed_vsram_volt_idx = 0 as the unconditional statement it is (clang -Wmisleading-indentation)
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: interactive: give the target to the driver when it equals policy->cur, for CPUFREQ_NEED_UPDATE_LIMITS drivers
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: ac8257: mt-cpufreq sets CPUFREQ_NEED_UPDATE_LIMITS (a governor request equal to the SSPM frequency was dropped)
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq / perfmgr: ac8257: the vendor OPP indexes are indexes of the stock table (boot boost OPP 0 meant 2601 MHz with the overclock table)
  • KernelNoyauBACKPORT: cpufreq: Introduce cpufreq_driver_test_flags()
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: governors: on a limits change, give a CPUFREQ_NEED_UPDATE_LIMITS driver the governor's request, not one built from policy->cur
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: ac8257: the SSPM bounds no longer overwrite scaling_min/max_freq (CPU kept at a boost floor after a governor change)
  • KernelNoyauBACKPORT: cpufreq: Introduce CPUFREQ_NEED_UPDATE_LIMITS driver flag
  • KernelNoyaucpufreq: ac8257: governor requests go to the SSPM unclamped, as the MediaTek governors' (a request froze a boost floor or a thermal limit)
  • Zipskernel-stable-4.9.337 / conn-modules-stable-4.9.337: status of r130 (USB safety nets after a resume, Android USB gadget locked against a function change), republished with the r130 build
  • KernelNoyauusb: gadget: configfs: android_setup() under gi->spinlock, as configfs_composite_setup()
  • KernelNoyauusb: hub: enumerate again at resume_end the ports b_is_in_suspend gave up (device left unenumerated after a resume)
  • KernelNoyauboot_state: send resume_end from the kernel when userspace does not (USB left in its suspend mode after a resume)
